paite: Huan ngai in, TOUPA thu in Judah gam a pan Bethel ah Pathian mipa khat ahong hi. Maitam chin ah gimlim hal ding in Jeroboam ana ding hi.
english: Behold, a man of God came out of Judah by Yahweh’s word to Bethel; and Jeroboam was standing by the altar to burn incense.

paite: Ama'n TOUPA thu in maitam akikoukhum a, "Maitam aw, maitam, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Ngai in, David inkuan ah tapa, amin Josiah ahong piang dia, ama'n na tung a gimlim halna mun sang a siampute na tung ah alan dia, na tung ah mihing guhte ahal ding, " achi hi.
english: He cried against the altar by Yahweh’s word, and said, “Altar! Altar! Yahweh says: ‘Behold, a son will be born to David’s house, Josiah by name. On you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense on you, and they will burn men’s bones on you.’”

paite: Huai ni mah in chiamtehna apia hi. “Hiai TOUPA'N chiamtehna ding achih ahi. Ngai in, maitam ahong khangkham dia, atung a meivute ahong bo vek ding," achi hi.
english: He gave a sign the same day, saying, “This is the sign which Yahweh has spoken: Behold, the altar will be split apart, and the ashes that are on it will be poured out.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pathian mipa in Bethel a maitam akikoukhum thu kumpipa'n azak in, Jeroboam in, "Man un," chi in maitam a pan akhut in asawk hi. Mat tum a asawkna khut azawta a, akhut akaikik nawn theita kei hi.
english: When the king heard the saying of the man of God, which he cried against the altar in Bethel, Jeroboam put out his hand from the altar, saying, “Seize him!” His hand, which he put out against him, dried up, so that he could not draw it back again to himself.

paite: Pathian mipa in TOUPA thu chiamtehna dia agen bang in maitam leng akhangkham a, maitam a meivute leng abo vek uhi.
english: The altar was also split apart, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by Yahweh’s word.

paite: Kumpipa'n adawng a, Pathian mipa kiang ah, "Ka khut ahong dam nawn theihna ding in TOUPA na Pathian hehpihna ngen inla, hon thumsak in," achi hi. Pathian min TOUPA kiang ah angen a, kumpipa khut ahong dam nawn a, amalam a bangmah in ahong om nawnta hi.
english: The king answered the man of God, “Now intercede for the favor of Yahweh your God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored to me.” The man of God interceded with Yahweh, and the king’s hand was restored to him, and became as it was before.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n Pathian mipa kiang ah, "Ka inn ah kei toh i pai dia hong kihihhalh tadih inla, huchi in kipahman ka hon pe ding," achi hi.
english: The king said to the man of God, “Come home with me and refresh yourself, and I will give you a reward.”

paite: Pathian mipa in kumpipa kiang ah, "Na inn kimkhat zah hon pe ding himah lechin leng na kiang ah ka hong pai tuan kei ding, hiai ah tanghou ne in tui himhim leng ka dawn sam kei ding.
english: The man of God said to the king, “Even if you gave me half of your house, I would not go in with you, neither would I eat bread nor drink water in this place;

paite: Tanghou va ne in tui himhim leng va dawn ke'nla, 'Na va hohna lampi ah leng kik nawn ke'n chi a TOUPA thu a sawl ka hi,' " achi hi.
english: for so was it commanded me by Yahweh’s word, saying, ‘You shall eat no bread, drink no water, and don’t return by the way that you came.’”

paite: Huchi in lampi dang ah apai a, Bethel a ahong kuanna lampi ah apaita kei hi.
english: So he went another way, and didn’t return by the way that he came to Bethel.

paite: Bethel ah zawlnei putek khat a-om hi. Atapate'n huai ni a Bethel a Pathian mipa thilhih tengteng ahilh vek uhi. Kumpipa kiang a athugente leng apa uh ahilh lai uhi.
heading: Bethel Ah Zawlnei Putek
english: Now an old prophet lived in Bethel, and one of his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel. They also told their father the words which he had spoken to the king.

paite: Apa un akiang uah, "Koi lampi atawn a?" achi hi. Atapate'n Judah gam a pan hong pai Pathian mipa pai nawnna lampi akawkmuh uhi.
english: Their father said to them, “Which way did he go?” Now his sons had seen which way the man of God went, who came from Judah.

paite: Huchi in atapate kiang ah, "Sabiltung hon bawlsak dih uh," achi hi. Sabiltung abawlsak ua; atung ah atuang hi.
english: He said to his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.” So they saddled the donkey for him; and he rode on it.

paite: Pathian mipa adelhta a, tosaw sing nuai a tu in ava mu hi. Akiang ah, "Nang na hi maw Judah gam a pan hong pai Pathian mipa?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Hi e,” achi hi.
english: He went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak. He said to him, “Are you the man of God who came from Judah?” He said, “I am.”

paite: Huchi in ama'n akiang ah, "Ka inn ah kei toh hong pai inla; tanghou hong ne dih ve,” achi hi.
english: Then he said to him, “Come home with me and eat bread.”

paite: Ama'n, "Nang toh kik nawn thei ka hi kei, na kiang a hong thei leng ka hi sam kei. Hiai ah na kiang ah tanghou ne in tui himhim leng ka dawn sam kei ding.
english: He said, “I may not return with you, nor go in with you. I will not eat bread or drink water with you in this place.

paite: Tanghou va ne in tui himhim leng va dawn ke'nla, na va hohna lampi ah leng kik nawn ke'n, chi a TOUPA thu a hilh lah ka hi ngal a,” achi hi.
english: For it was said to me by Yahweh’s word, ‘You shall eat no bread or drink water there, and don’t turn again to go by the way that you came.’”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Kei leng nangmah bang a zawlnei ka hi. Angel in TOUPA thu in, tanghoute ne a tuite dawn ding in na inn ah pikik nawn in, chi in ahon houpih hi," achi hi. Himahleh akiang ah zuau agen hi.
english: He said to him, “I also am a prophet as you are; and an angel spoke to me by Yahweh’s word, saying, ‘Bring him back with you into your house, that he may eat bread and drink water.’” He lied to him.

paite: Huchi in akiang ah akik nawn a, a-inn ah tanghoute ne in tui adawnta hi.
english: So he went back with him, ate bread in his house, and drank water.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, dohkan a-um lai un, apikik nawnpa zawlnei kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: As they sat at the table, Yahweh’s word came to the prophet who brought him back;

paite: Huchi in Judah gam a pan hong pai Pathian mipa kiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "TOUPA thugen mang lou a, TOUPA na Pathian in thu ahon piak na zuih louh a,
english: and he cried out to the man of God who came from Judah, saying, “Yahweh says, ‘Because you have been disobedient to Yahweh’s word, and have not kept the commandment which Yahweh your God commanded you,

paite: hong kik nawn a, tanghou ne in tui leng dawn ke'n, ka chihna mun mahmah a tanghou ne a, tui na dawn ziak in na luang na pute han a koih ahi kei ding," chi in agenkheta hi.
english: but came back, and have eaten bread and drank water in the place of which he said to you, “Eat no bread, and drink no water,” your body will not come to the tomb of your fathers.’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, tanghou ne a, tui adawn zoh in, zawlnei pikik nawnpa'n sabiltung abawlsak hi.
english: After he had eaten bread and after he drank, he saddled the donkey for the prophet whom he had brought back.

paite: Huchi in apaita a lamkal ah humpinelkai toh akituak ua, ana that hi. Aluang lampi ah akipai a, akiang ah sabiltung adingh a, humpinelkai leng siluang kiang ah adingh hi.
english: When he had gone, a lion met him by the way and killed him. His body was thrown on the path, and the donkey stood by it. The lion also stood by the body.

paite: Ngai in, mi ava pai ua, lampi a siluang kipai leh siluang kiang a humpinelkai dingh amu ua; zawlnei putek tenna khua ah ava gen uhi.
english: Behold, men passed by and saw the body thrown on the path, and the lion standing by the body; and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet lived.

paite: Lamkal a pan va pikik nawnpa zawlnei in huai thu ana zaktak in, "Pathian mi, TOUPA thugen mang nuamloupa ei ve. Huchi in ToUPA'N akiang a agen, athu bangbang a TOUPA'N humpinelkai kiang a pia a, na ham a, na keilum ahita ve," achi hi.
english: When the prophet who brought him back from the way heard of it, he said, “It is the man of God who was disobedient to Yahweh’s word. Therefore Yahweh has delivered him to the lion, which has mauled him and slain him, according to Yahweh’s word which he spoke to him.”

paite: Atapate kiang ah, "Sabiltung hon bawlsak dih uh," chi in agen a; abawlsak uhi.
english: He said to his sons, saying, “Saddle the donkey for me,” and they saddled it.

paite: Huchi in akuanta a, aluang lampi a kipai leh sabiltung leh humpinelkai a luang kiang a dingh ava mu hi. Humpinelkai in luang ana ne nai kei a, sabiltung leng ana ham kei hi.
english: He went and found his body thrown on the path, and the donkey and the lion standing by the body. The lion had not eaten the body nor mauled the donkey.

paite: Zawlnei in Pathian mipa luang adom a, sabiltung tung ah akoih a, akikpihta hi. Huchi in zawlnei putek tenna khua ah suun ding leh vui ding in alalut hi.
english: The prophet took up the body of the man of God, and laid it on the donkey, and brought it back. He came to the city of the old prophet to mourn, and to bury him.

paite: Aluang ama han ah asial a, "Ka unaupa khawk hi na mah e!" chi in asuun uhi.
english: He laid his body in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, “Alas, my brother!”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, avui khit nung in atapate kiang ah, "Ka sih chiang in Pathian mipa kivuina han ah hon vui sam un. Aguhte kiang ah ka guhte koih un.
english: After he had buried him, he spoke to his sons, saying, “When I am dead, bury me in the tomb in which the man of God is buried. Lay my bones beside his bones.

paite: Pathian thu a Bethel a maitam leh Samaria gam khopite a mun sangte inn tengteng akikoukhumna thu hong tung ngeingei ding ahi,” achi hi.
english: For the saying which he cried by Yahweh’s word against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, will surely happen.”

paite: Huai thil zoh in Jeroboam in a omdan diklou atawpsan tuan kei hi. Miniampente lak a mun sang siampu dia abawl siampute a-omtheihna ding un adeihdeih ahihtuam hi.
heading: Jeroboam Khelhna
english: After this thing, Jeroboam didn’t turn from his evil way, but again made priests of the high places from among all the people. Whoever wanted to, he consecrated him, that there might be priests of the high places.

paite: Huai thil Jeroboam inkuan khelhna amau inn gamsaktu leh leitung maikaih a pan hihmangthangtu ahong hita hi.
english: This thing became sin to the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off and to destroy it from off the surface of the earth.
